account.text: Select the correct game version and sign in to your account.

multiplayer.text: Open the Multiplayer tab and click Add Server.

address.text: Paste the IP address you copied below into the Server Address field.

join.text: Click Done, select Builtechraft, and join the game.

open.text: Open Minecraft Bedrock Edition on your PC or mobile device.

servers.text: Tap Play and open the Servers tab.

add.text: Scroll to the bottom of the list and choose Add Server.

details.text: Enter any server name, paste the IP, and add the port shown below.

join.text: Save the server to your list and select Join.
